status.description: Outcome envelope status: 'completed' asserts verification executed and succeeded, 'failed' indicates verification or infrastructure failure.

device_verified.description: Whether PyTorch successfully acquired and verified the TPU device.

device_type.description: Actual device type that performed the computation (e.g., native-tpu, cpu-fallback, cpu-simulated).

parity_passed.description: Whether numerical parity verification between TPU and CPU reference passed within tolerance.

failure_reason.description: Structured failure reason when status is failed (e.g., no_device, parity_mismatch, dispatch_failed, credential_expired, timeout).

error_message.description: Detailed diagnostic error message explaining the failure.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the verification outcome.

examples.summary: TPU verified successfully on native-tpu with numerical parity against CPU reference.

examples.error_message: No TPU runtime detected: falling back to CPU.
examples.summary: TPU verification failed: no TPU device detected.
